title: Add Lumina Chat to chat
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Lumina Chat](https://lumina.magnified.cc) to chat
- Lumina is an AI chat application designed to provide a seamless and flexible interface for interacting with large language models. The app includes built-in support for Pollinations.AI as a default pr

Fixes #12713

gist.headline: A bright new chat window
gist.blurb: Lumina Chat has landed in the garden: a flexible AI chat app with Pollinations.AI already wired in as a default provider. One less thing between an idea and a conversation with a model.
gist.summary: Added Lumina Chat to the community apps directory, highlighting its flexible LLM chat interface and built-in Pollinations.AI support as a default provider.
gist.impact: People looking for a ready-to-use chat interface can now discover Lumina Chat and start using Pollinations-powered conversations with less setup.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Lumina Chat as a cozy glowing retro chat terminal in a garden workspace, with friendly message bubbles and several tiny model icons represented as soft pastel stars. Polli, wearing tiny headphones, hovers beside the terminal while tending a code-plant growing from its base, making the built-in Pollinations connection feel natural and welcoming.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow bee mascot with dark brown stripes, pink rectangular blush, light blue wings, and tiny headphones, happily tending a code-plant beside a glowing retro chat terminal labeled "LUMINA CHAT" in simple pixel font; soft pastel message bubbles float above the screen and pixel flowers grow around the desk. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with Polli small-to-medium in the scene and a warm inviting hackerspace atmosphere.
